source_citation: FR-4/ENIG stackup and BGA pitch from JEDEC/published PCB fabrication standards (IPC-4101 FR-4 laminate spec, IPC-7351 BGA land-pattern standard); SMD 0402 dimensions from EIA/published passive-component footprints (2.0×1.0 mm body, IEC 60063); silicon interposer dimensions from published TPU v1 analyses (Jouppi et al., ISCA 2017) and Apple-M published die analyses; IHS lid from Intel LGA published package drawings (dimensional class reference); SoC floorplan block names/counts from 05_chip_architecture_benchmarks.json and 07_soc_interposer_memory_baselines.json.
license_or_access: public standards (IPC/JEDEC summaries); vendor-published package figures

enig.note: Electroless Nickel Immersion Gold finish per IPC-4552

bga_array.ball_material: SAC305 lead-free solder (96.5% Sn, 3% Ag, 0.5% Cu), melting 217 °C (published SAC305 datasheet)

array.scene_note: representative corner array shown on the package edge; parametric count

smd_passives.placement: adjacent to each power pin pair on the package perimeter

interposer.bus_trace_note: NoC routes modelled as 1 cycle per hop (07_soc_interposer_memory_baselines.json interposer_reference)

ihs_lid.material: brushed aluminum (alloy class reference: 6063-T5 published thermal conductivity ~200 W/m·K)
ihs_lid.state: starts lifted/cutaway (v3 default) or toggles cleanly; exposes the interposer + dies

parametric_bindings.generator_contract: Bay3Soc renders the package from this spec; block positions/sizes are the scene-truth source; thermal zones map 1:1 to blocks; every dimension traces here or to 02/05/07 JSON
